title: Royal Vanilla +
description: Royal Vanilla + is a Vanilla+ Fabric modpack for Minecraft that enhances the vanilla experience with improved visuals, shaders, animations, sounds, gameplay, and quality-of-life features.
body:
# Royal Vanilla +

**Royal Vanilla +** is a Vanilla+ Fabric modpack for Minecraft (Currently)-**1.21.5** that enhances the vanilla game with better performance, visuals, audio, animations, and quality-of-life features, while keeping the classic Minecraft feel.

It combines mods, datapacks, shaders, and resource packs to let you explore, build, and adventure in a smoother, more immersive world.

---

## What You’ll Experience

- **Richer terrain & biomes** — Improved landscapes, foliage, and structures with Terralith, Yung’s mods, and datapacks  
- **Smooth animations** — Better player and mob movement, enhanced particles, and effects  
- **Lighting & shaders** — Enhanced lighting, shadows, and textures with Iris, Sodium Extra, BSL, and Complementary Reimagined  
- **Immersive sound** — Custom footsteps, ambient audio, and environmental effects  
- **Gameplay & QoL** — VeinMiner, Inventory HUD, CarryOn, Easy Elytra Takeoff, Controlling, and more  
- **Building & exploration** — Better beacons, improved mob visuals, and visual effects

---

## Key Mods & Packs

AppleSkin, BetterAdvancements, VeinMiner, CarryOn, Easy Elytra Takeoff, Armor Stand Arms, Yung’s Better Dungeons/Mineshafts/Strongholds, Lukis’ Ancient Cities, Complementary Reimagined & BSL shaders, AL’s Revamped Mobs, Drodi’s Illagers, and more.

---

## About the Pack

This is my **first modpack**, created as a personal project. I’ve tested and fixed as many crashes, bugs, and glitches as possible. It runs smoothly most of the time, though minor performance issues or rare bugs may appear in specific situations. These will be improved in future updates.

---

## Goals

- Deliver a polished and immersive Vanilla+ experience  
- Enhance visuals, animations, sounds, and gameplay while staying true to vanilla  
- Easy to install for singleplayer and multiplayer  
- Continuously refine performance and stability

---

## Conclusion

Royal Vanilla + is a labor of love from a single creator. My aim is to give players a fun, immersive, and modern Vanilla+ experience while keeping the charm of classic Minecraft. I hope you enjoy it as much as I enjoyed making it!
